summary: RingCentral filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, solely to announce that its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders will be held November 2, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Pacific time. Because the meeting date is more than 30 days earlier than the prior annual meeting's anniversary, Rule 14a-5(f) requires adjusted deadlines: Rule 14a-8 proposals and non-14a-8 nominations or proposals must be received at the principal executive offices before 11:59 p.m. Pacific on October 9, 2026, with compliance under bylaws and Rule 14a-19. Item 5.08 incorporates the same disclosure. No transaction, stake, price, or recommendation is involved.
